raw: {"status":"complete","answer":{"question_id":935,"db":"MYSQL","query":"SELECT SUM(es.installed_capacity) AS total_installed_capacity FROM energy.energy_station es JOIN common.administrative_division ad ON es.area_id = ad.id JOIN common.station_type_dict std ON es.station_type_code = std.type_code WHERE ad.city_name = '衡阳市' AND std.type_name = '火电';"},"requirements":[{"requirement":"统计衡阳市发电场站中火电场的装机容量","tables":["MYSQL:energy.energy_station","MYSQL:common.administrative_division","MYSQL:common.station_type_dict"],"columns":["installed_capacity","area_id","city_name","station_type_code","type_name"]}],"assumptions":["场站类型字典中火电场的类型名称为'火电'","衡阳市通过行政区划表的city_name字段识别"]}
